note: Credit repair lead-gen brochure site: an open catalogue of services, a lead form for personal info + credit status, and a self-service credit score inquiry whose score/band/advice are derived (no bureau) from the four factors the visitor reports — payment history, utilisation, open accounts, late payments.

CreditInquiry.name: text!
CreditInquiry.score: int := max(300, min(850, round(300 + if(paymentHistory = 'always_on_time', 200, if(paymentHistory = 'mostly_on_time', 140, if(paymentHistory = 'some_late', 80, 20))) + (100 - utilization) * 2 + min(openAccounts, 10) * 5 - latePayments * 15, 0)))
CreditInquiry.advice: text := if(score >= 750, 'Excellent score - you likely qualify for the best rates available.', if(score >= 670, 'Good score - a few improvements could unlock even better offers.', if(score >= 580, 'Fair score - paying down balances and avoiding late payments will help the most.', 'Lower score - a personalised credit repair plan can help you improve it step by step.')))
